# ABDM Developer Portal

> Documentation for integrating with ABDM, India's health data exchange: the HIE-CM gateway milestones M1 to M3, the ABHA, HPR and HFR registries, UHI, and the NHCX claims exchange between hospitals and insurers. Nothing here has been run against the ABDM sandbox unless a page says so, so treat request and response shapes as unconfirmed.

Add `.md` to any link below to get that page as markdown. Individual API operations are not listed here: each module has its own `llms.txt` naming every call it carries, linked under Optional. `llms-full.txt` beside this file carries every page in one document.

## docs/hiecm

- [API references](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api): Every operation published for this gateway, module by module.
- [Gateway session](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway): Every ABDM call carries a bearer token from one endpoint. This is that endpoint, plus the certificate and bridge registration calls that sit beside it.
- [Gateway session errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/errors): What Gateway session returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [M1 ABHA identity](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1): M1 base URLs and the operations grouped by use case.
- [M1 APIs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/apis): The rules that hold across every M1 endpoint. Base URLs, how scope picks the job, RSA encryption, and the two token rule.
- [M1 ABHA identity errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/errors): What M1 ABHA identity returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [M2 linking and sharing](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2): M2 base URLs and the operations grouped by use case.
- [M2 Linking and sharing errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/errors): What M2 Linking and sharing returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [M3 consent and fetching](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3): The M3 operations grouped by use case.
- [M3 Consent and fetching errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m3/errors): What M3 Consent and fetching returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [M4 HPR and HFR](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m4): M4 base URLs and the HPR and HFR operations.
- [M4 HPR and HFR errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m4/errors): What M4 HPR and HFR returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [M4 operations and fields](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m4/undocumented): Every M4 call for the HPR and the HFR, with its parameters, codes and rules, including the calls whose path is not yet published.
- [P1 PHR identity and profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1): How a patient gets into their own PHR: registration, login, the profile they see, the family members they manage.
- [P1 PHR identity and profile errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/errors): What P1 PHR identity and profile returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [P2 PHR linking and records](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2): How a patient finds records held elsewhere and attaches them to their ABHA address.
- [P2 PHR linking and records errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/errors): What P2 PHR linking and records returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [P3 PHR consent and notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3): How a patient grants, reviews and revokes consent, and how they are told any of it happened.
- [P3 PHR consent and notifications errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/errors): What P3 PHR consent and notifications returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [PHR application services](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services): Services a PHR application can offer on top of ABDM. Not a certification milestone.
- [PHR application services errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/errors): What PHR application services returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Proving a callback came from ABDM](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/callback-authenticity): Your callback URL is a public address, so anything can post to it. How ABDM signs what it sends, and how to check that before your handler acts.
- [Consent](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/consent): What a consent request is, what a consent artefact is, who holds it, and the states it moves through.
- [How a record travels](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/data-flow): The path a health record takes from the system that asks for it to the system that holds it, and the encryption in between.
- [Encryption](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/encryption): Which values must be encrypted before they go in a request body, why it is required, and why you encrypt inside your own system rather than through a helper.
- [FHIR and health record formats](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/fhir): The R4 profiles ABDM uses, the document bundle every record travels in, and how to validate one before you ship it.
- [The ABDM gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/gateway): The routing layer every ABDM call goes through, and the session endpoint that issues your token.
- [Hospital, lab and pharmacy systems](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/hip-hiu): What a facility does as a health information provider in ABDM, and how care context linking fits into a clinical workflow.
- [How the pieces fit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/how-it-fits): The registries, the HIE-CM gateway, the two roles a record moves between, and where a health record actually lives.
- [Care contexts and linking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/linking): What a care context is, why a record has to be linked before anyone can find it, and how the link token works.
- [Ecosystem participants](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants): The eight participants on India's health data network, the identifier each one holds, and what each can do.
- [Citizen](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/citizen): What an ABHA gives a person, what consent means in practice, and what a citizen controls on the network.
- [Doctor](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/doctor): The HPR ID a healthcare professional holds, how it is issued, and what it unlocks for the facility they work in.
- [Hospital](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/hospital): The facility ID a hospital holds, the HIP and HIU roles it takes, and what registering on ABDM gets it.
- [Insurer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/insurer): An insurer reads records as an HIU under consent, and settles claims on NHCX, a separate gateway with its own onboarding.
- [Diagnostics](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/lab): A laboratory or imaging centre takes the same roles as a hospital, with a narrower record surface. What differs and what does not.
- [NHA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/nha): The National Health Authority runs ABDM. What it operates, what it issues, and what that gives the systems on the network.
- [Pharmacy](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/pharmacy): A pharmacy takes the same roles as a hospital, with a narrower record surface. What differs, and what runs on another gateway.
- [PHR app](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/phr): The citizen facing app: what identifies it, the three milestones it builds, and why it is where consent happens.
- [PHR applications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/phr): What a personal health record app does in ABDM, the screens it needs, and the modules you have to build.
- [Get started](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started): Connect your application to India's health data network, from sandbox credentials to your first call to going live.
- [Build it well](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/build-it-well): What to validate before you call, what to do with each error, what is safe to retry, and what the person at the counter sees while it happens.
- [Build with AI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/build-with-ai): Set a coding agent up to build your ABDM integration, from a one-file skill to live retrieval over MCP.
- [Quickstart](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/first-fifteen-minutes): Create a gateway session and then create your first ABHA, live from this page, with your own sandbox credentials.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms used across this documentation, and the HIE-CM ones, defined once.
- [Go live](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/going-live): Complete the sandbox exit process, two demonstrations, functional testing, the security audit and the exit form, then switch to production.
- [Get your sandbox credentials](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/sandbox): Register on the sandbox, collect your client id and secret, register a callback URL, and note the base URLs.
- [Security audit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/security-audit): Pass the WASA security audit and hold a Safe to Host certificate, which every application needs before it runs in production.
- [Milestones](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones): The four milestones spell CARE. Create, Attach, Retrieve, Enrol, in build order, plus the three PHR milestones and which ones you need.
- [M1 Create: ABHA identity](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m1): What Milestone 1 gives you, what you need before your first call, and the order to build it in.
- [M2 Attach: linking and sharing](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m2): What Milestone 2 gives you, the prerequisites that block it, the record types you can link, and the order to build it in.
- [M3 Retrieve: consent and fetching](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m3): What Milestone 3 gives you, who asks the patient for consent, what you store, and the order to build it in.
- [M4 Enrol: facilities and professionals](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m4): What Milestone 4 covers, who needs it, how the two registries connect, and when to build it rather than use the NHPR portal.
- [P1 Identity and profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p1): The patient side of M1: how a person registers in your PHR app, logs in four ways, and holds their own profile and ABHA card.
- [P2 Linking and records](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p2): The patient side of M2: how a PHR app finds records held elsewhere, links them to an ABHA address, and shares a profile at a facility.
- [P3 Consent and notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p3): The patient side of M3: subscriptions, auto approval, granting and revoking consent, and fetching the records a grant covers.
- [Authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/authentication): The credentials every ABDM call carries, and the headers that go with them.
- [Sandbox data dictionary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/data-dictionary): The tables and columns behind the ABDM sandbox portal, grouped by what each one records.
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/error-codes): Every error code the specifications carry, with its message and what to do.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/registries): What an ABDM registry is, why there are two, and where ABHA, HPR and HFR sit.
- [ABHA, the patient registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/abha): The registry that identifies patients, the 14 digit ABHA number, the ABHA address, and what every milestone assumes about both.
- [NHPR, the provider registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr): The National Health Professional Registry, why professionals and facilities are registered separately, and which one you need first.
- [HFR, the facility registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr/hfr): The Health Facility Registry, what a facility record holds, the five call onboarding sequence, and how a bridge is linked to it.
- [HPR, the professional registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr/hpr): The Healthcare Professionals Registry, the HPID, what identifies a doctor, and the registration journey.
- [Developer resources](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/resources): What sits beside the API reference for HIE-CM. Today that is the testing use cases, one page per module.
- [Testing use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/resources/testing): The cases every HIE-CM module is tested against, where you run them, and how to read a case id and its marking.
- [M1 testing use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/resources/testing/m1): The cases M1 is tested against. ABHA creation on four routes, verification, profile read and update, and profile sharing.
- [M2 testing use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/resources/testing/m2): The cases M2 is tested against. Care context linking on five authentication routes, user initiated linking, and the data transfer.
- [M3 testing use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/resources/testing/m3): The cases M3 is tested against. Raising a consent request, what comes back on each outcome, and revoking or expiring one.
- [M4 testing use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/resources/testing/m4): The cases M4 is tested against. Facility search, registration and update in the HFR, bridge linkage, and HPR professional registration.
- [When something breaks](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting): Find the symptom you are seeing, not the error code, and work through the checks in order.
- [Accepted, then nothing](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/accepted-then-nothing): Discovery or care context linking started, the first call was accepted, and the flow stalled somewhere in the middle.
- [The callback never arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/callback-never-arrives): A call returned 202, and nothing followed on your registered callback URL. The checks in order.
- [Consent stuck in Requested](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/consent-stuck-requested): A consent request was created and never moved to Granted or Denied. The checks in order.
- [Everything returns 401](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/everything-returns-401): Every call fails the same way, not just one endpoint. The checks in order, before you assume the gateway is down.
- [The OTP never arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/otp-never-arrives): You requested an OTP and nothing reached the phone. The checks in order.

## docs/nhcx

- [Introduction](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1): What NHCX is, objectives, participants, machine-readable specifications
- [API references](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api): Every operation published for this gateway, module by module.
- [PMJAY adjudicator](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/adjudicator): The PMJAY adjudicator calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [ABHA biometric authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/biometric): The ABHA biometric authentication calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [ABHA biometric authentication errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/biometric/errors): What ABHA biometric authentication returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Claim](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/claim): The Claim calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Claim errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/claim/errors): What Claim returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/communication): The Communication calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Communication errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/communication/errors): What Communication returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Coverage eligibility](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/eligibility): The Coverage eligibility calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Coverage eligibility errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/eligibility/errors): What Coverage eligibility returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan): The Insurance plan calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Insurance plan errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/insurance-plan/errors): What Insurance plan returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Onboarding](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/onboarding): The Onboarding calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Other](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other): The Other calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Other errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/errors): What Other returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Payment notice](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice): The Payment notice calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Payment notice errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/payment-notice/errors): What Payment notice returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Pre-authorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth): The Pre-authorisation calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Pre-authorisation errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/preauth/errors): What Pre-authorisation returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Predetermination](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/predetermination): The Predetermination calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Predetermination errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/predetermination/errors): What Predetermination returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Participant registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/registry): The Participant registry calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Session](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/session): The Session calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Status and search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status): The Status and search calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Status and search errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/errors): What Status and search returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [How claims move on NHCX](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/how-claims-move-on-nhcx): End-to-end claim journey in plain language
- [JWE, status and errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/jwe-status-and-errors): Envelope/letter model, cross-gateway relay, unified correlation ID, status lifecycle (`request.stopped`)
- [NHCX Use Cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/nhcx-use-cases): Catalog of all 40 NHA use cases across A, B, C, D, E series
- [Payer flexibility](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/payer-flexibility): How each payer configures queries, answers and case numbers
- [PMJAY on NHCX](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/pmjay-on-nhcx): What the Ayushman Bharat scheme changes on the network
- [PMJAY Scheme Rules and HMIS Integration](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/pmjay-scheme-rules): Package-based tariffs, LM100 LAMA/DAMA arithmetic and `los` bounding
- [PMJAY use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/pmjay-use-cases): PMJAY-specific use cases D1 to D13
- [Workflow Codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/workflow-codes): The 74 workflow IDs and their message directions
- [Base URLs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/base-urls): Every service's base in the sandbox and in production, from `baseurl.yaml`
- [Build with AI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/build-with-ai): Give your coding agent the NHCX documentation and skills: over the Docs MCP server, as agent skills, or as Markdown it fetches.
- [Building and sending a JWE](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/building-and-sending-a-jwe): RSA-OAEP-256 + A256GCM compact serialisation
- [Creating and updating a participant](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/creating-and-updating-a-participant): Registry onboarding and participant updates
- [Fetching a recipient certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/fetching-a-recipient-certificate): Certificate discovery and caching discipline
- [Finding participants and policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/finding-participants-and-policies): Search endpoints and policy resolution
- [Get your sandbox credentials](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/get-your-sandbox-credentials): Register the organisation, get an ABDM client ID and secret, take NHCX sandbox roles, and meet the dummy payer
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/glossary): Definitive glossary of protocol, healthcare, and scheme terms
- [NHCX adapter (Optional)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/nhcx-adapter): Turnkey protocol adapter implementation, optional
- [Quickstart](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/quickstart): Three calls with only your credentials: a session token, the dummy payer's registry record, and its certificate
- [Receiving a callback](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/receiving-a-callback): Asynchronous callback listener and 202 receipt handling
- [Session token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/session-token): Minting and refreshing ABDM gateway session JWTs
- [Status and search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/status-and-search): Status checking (`/v1/status`) and search queries (`/v1/search/submit`)
- [The base framework](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/the-base-framework): Six-step base client architecture
- [Your certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/your-certificate): RSA-2048 key pair generation and self-signed certificate assembly
- [Going live](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/go-live): Sandbox exit, production credentials, registering in production, switching addresses, the network path, the PMJAY cutover and the pilot
- [Security audit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/go-live/security-audit): The security tests for your role, the WASA audit, STQC or CERT-In review, and the certificates production asks for
- [Access control and roles](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/access-control-and-roles): Role permissions, search rights, consent headers, and registry attributes (`payment_details`)
- [Authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/authentication): The credentials every ABDM call carries, and the headers that go with them.
- [Envelope fields](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/envelope-fields): Full JWE header table, obligations, and correlation rules
- [Environments and addresses](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/environments-and-addresses): Sandbox/production URLs, firewall IPs, token headers, and 12 live Swagger specifications
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/error-code-guide): Directory of 309 error codes, the three code spaces, and collisions
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/error-codes): Every error code the specifications carry, with its message and what to do.
- [Bundles and conventions](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir): Universal bundle rules, profiles, IDs, base64 encoding, and size limits
- [Cancel, reprocess and shortfall](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/cancel-reprocess-and-shortfall): Task-based cancel (`cancel`), reprocess (`reprocess`), balance release (`release`) and `nullify`
- [Claim query and answer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/claim-query-and-answer): Claim query updates (wf 27 / 151)
- [Claim request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/claim-request): Final claim bundle, `billablePeriod`, discharge evidence, and invoice attachments
- [Claim response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/claim-response): Claim decisions, item adjudications, and verified rejection bundles (wf 291)
- [Codes and value sets](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/codes-and-value-sets): All code systems, bindings, and known NHA discrepancies
- [Communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/communication): Out-of-band communication payloads and reason codes
- [Coverage eligibility request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/coverage-eligibility-request): Resource breakdown and fields
- [Coverage eligibility response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/coverage-eligibility-response): Response bundle, wallet breakdown, and inforce flags
- [Insurance plan request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-request): Task-based plan polling request
- [Insurance plan response, coverage-based](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-response-coverage-based): Commercial insurance plan layout
- [Insurance plan response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-response-overview): Collection bundle overview and questionnaires
- [Insurance plan response, package-based](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/insurance-plan-response-package-based): PMJAY package structure and claim condition extensions
- [Payment notice and acknowledgement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/payment-notice-and-acknowledgement): Payment notices, reconciliations, and payment receipts
- [Preauthorisation enhancement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-enhancement): Enhancement payload, header `x-hcx-use_case: Enhancement`, and increment totals
- [Preauthorisation query and answer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-query-and-answer): Query resolution on preauth thread (wf 24 / 19)
- [Preauthorisation request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-request): Preauth Claim bundle, items, and ABDM clinical attachments
- [Preauthorisation response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/preauthorisation-response): ClaimResponse, approvals, queries, and verified rejection bundles (wf 23)
- [Predetermination, status and search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/fhir/predetermination-status-and-search): Specification and schemas for predetermination, status, and search
- [Governance and audit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/governance-and-audit): Security layers, dual JWTs, log retention, grievance redressal, and onboarding checklist
- [Notifications and patient apps](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/notifications-and-patient-apps): Beneficiary service provider integration, subscription model, and push events
- [Troubleshooting](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/troubleshooting): Five-layer fault isolation model and symptom-first diagnostic playbook
- [Participants and policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/registries): Registry records, identifiers, policy lookups
- [Payer overview](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer): Insurer and TPA ingestion architecture
- [Adjudicating claims](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/adjudicating-claims): Adjudicating claims, deductions, dispute handling, and rejection bundles
- [Adjudicating preauthorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/adjudicating-preauthorisation): Evaluating medical necessity, raising queries, approval, and rejection
- [Eligibility response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/eligibility-response): Constructing coverage eligibility answers across all 4 purposes
- [Payer checklist](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/payer-checklist): Payer sandbox exit list, the four validations, 26 test cases by family (T-ELG, T-PLN, T-PRE, T-CLM, T-TSK, T-PAY, T-COM, T-ENV)
- [Payment notice and communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/payment-notice-and-communication): Dispatching payment notices and operational intimations
- [Policies and plans](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/policies-and-plans): Publishing policy master and 21 MB plan bundles
- [Payer UI guide](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/payer/ui-guide): Payer adjudication desk screens and workflow
- [Provider overview](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider): Hospital integration architecture and queue flow
- [Biometric authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/biometric-authentication): ABDM biometric pipeline: Fingerprint, Iris, FaceAuth, and exemption consent
- [Discharge and claim](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/discharge-and-claim): Cashless claim submission, discharge types, and billing evidence
- [Insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/insurance-plan): Dynamic package master retrieval and caching
- [Payment and communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/payment-and-communication): Payment reconciliations (wf 30, 31, 33) and out-of-band communication
- [PMJAY adjudication APIs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/pmjay-adjudication-apis): The two payer service calls that read and drive a PMJAY case, the role walk, and what the desk refuses
- [PMJAY provider](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/pmjay-provider): PMJAY-specific HMIS rules, STG questionnaires, GST, incentives, and size limits
- [PMJAY sandbox run](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/pmjay-sandbox-run): A full PMJAY case on the sandbox in order, the refusals met and what each means, with placeholders for your own values
- [Preauthorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/preauthorisation): Preauth request submission, clinical attachments, and query handling
- [Provider checklist](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/provider-checklist): Sandbox exit list, 29 test cases by family (T-ML1, T-PLN, T-ELG, T-PRE, T-CLM, T-PAY, T-COM, T-CBK, T-SES), first-week failures
- [Registration and eligibility](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/registration-and-eligibility): Patient intake, Aadhaar eKYC and biometrics, and the coverage check
- [Provider UI guide](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/roles/provider/ui-guide): Provider desk wireframes and UX recommendations
- [When something breaks](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting): Find the symptom you see, not the error code, and open the chapter that walks its checks
- [Accepted with 202, and no callback arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/accepted-then-no-callback): The exchange answered 202 and no callback followed: the six checks in order
- [Every NHCX call returns 401](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/every-call-returns-401): Every endpoint fails the same way: the token, its prefix, its header or its environment
- [Responses arrive against the wrong request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/responses-arrive-against-the-wrong-request): Answers on the wrong case, duplicates refused, callbacks unmatched: correlation and API call IDs
- [The payer rejects your FHIR bundle](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/the-payer-rejects-your-bundle): `PAYR-1004`, `PAYR-1008` and the missing identifier codes: validate, then check shape, identifiers and attachments
- [The recipient cannot decrypt your message](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/the-recipient-cannot-decrypt): A `PAYR-1001` protocol response: the certificate, its cache, the algorithms and the compact form
- [Your callback URL is rejected or never called](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/nhcx/v1/troubleshooting/your-callback-url-is-rejected): The endpoint update is refused, or nothing ever reaches your server

## docs/support

- [Support](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/support): Where to ask about the sandbox, and what to put in a report.

## docs/uhi

- [Introduction](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1): What UHI is, the two roles you can build, and how far each service goes today.
- [UHI API reference](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/api): What is published for the UHI gateway today, and where the message shapes come from.
- [UHI gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/network-and-protocol): The open network for discovering and booking health services, its two roles, and its signing scheme.
- [Ambulance booking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/ambulance-booking): Find an ambulance nearby and get a quote from the provider, using the two call pairs live in this service today.
- [AMRIT Pharmacy discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/amrit-pharmacy): Find AMRIT Pharmacy stores over UHI by store code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Blood bank discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/blood-bank): Search live blood stock by group and component across registered blood banks, using one call pair.
- [Jan Aushadhi Kendra discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-kendra): Find Jan Aushadhi Kendras over UHI by Kendra code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Jan Aushadhi medicine search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-medicine-search): Search the Jan Aushadhi medicine catalogue, then find the Kendras that stock a chosen medicine.
- [Physical consultation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/physical-consultation): Doctor discovery, appointment booking, PIN check-in and the full appointment lifecycle on UHI.
- [PM-JAY HEM hospital discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/pmjay-hem): Find PM-JAY empanelled hospitals over UHI by state, district, speciality, facility name, pincode or GPS.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms UHI shares, and the two roles that belong to UHI alone.
- [Onboarding to UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/onboarding): How an application joins the UHI network, from the M2 gate to sandbox sign-off and production go-live.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/registries): The registry UHI runs itself, the three ABDM identifiers that ride inside UHI messages, and which of them onboarding actually asks for.
- [ABHA on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/registries/abha): Where a patient's ABHA address appears in UHI messages, in which services it is mandatory, and what UHI does not do with it.
- [HFR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hfr): The one UHI service that carries an HFR ID, the tag it travels in, and what is issued at onboarding.
- [HPR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-12/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hpr): Where a practitioner's HPR ID appears in a UHI catalogue and a UHI order, and the two forms it takes.
